data.name: Ujjwal
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, ‘Ujjwal’ is derived from the root word ‘ujj’ meaning ‘to illuminate’. This name signifies brilliance, radiance, and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Ujjwal is also the name of the god Agni, who is the god of fire, and is believed to bring light, knowledge, and warmth.
